profile.name: Pramod Gobburi
profile.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.tagline: I build reliable, end-to-end systems — from cloud infrastructure and micro-services to the interfaces people actually use.

about.heading: About
body: I'm a full-stack software engineer with experience spanning legacy enterprise systems, greenfield micro-services, mobile apps, and embedded devices. I like owning a problem across the whole stack — designing the cloud infrastructure, building the services, and shipping the interface.
Most recently I've worked on prescription-management systems at Covetrus, and before that built marketplace apps, merchant dashboards, and self-order kiosks at Gophr and 360Fuel.

highlights: Contributed to the support and security maintenance of various legacy Spring applications.
Worked with multiple teams to develop new features for an online prescription management system.
Developed and deployed a third-party prescription management integration for external veterinary practice management systems (PIMS).
Developed a micro-service that facilitates kiosk and mobile ordering.
Iterated on the development and deployment of the 360Fuel Android application.
Integrated embedded systems such as card readers and printers onto gas dispensers.
Developed a client-facing web ordering dashboard in Next.js.
Designed and implemented cloud infrastructure in AWS.
Designed and developed multiple micro-services in ExpressJS and full-stack applications in Django and MeteorJS.
Developed a mobile marketplace application using React Native.
Developed internal and merchant-facing responsive dashboards using React.
Developed multiple REST APIs and full-stack web applications using the Django framework.
Developed various software components for a self-order kiosk and food-ordering mobile app.
Developed embedded systems that facilitated content delivery.
Offered consulting services for local businesses regarding software systems design.
Developed ETL and automation scripts in Python.
Developed a web application that facilitated equipment tracking and scheduling.
